verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents files listing, uploads, permissions, custom properties, push notifications and the changes resource. None of it mentions a revisions resource, listing or restoring file revisions via the API, or documented revision retention windows. The changes resource tracks change events, which is a different capability from addressable version history, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, version history is addressable — file revisions can be listed and restored via the API, with documented retention windows
